scope: Finite actual Mac12 runtime29 fixed-state comparison; not full application pixel or interaction acceptance
coordinates: Native pixels, half-open; independent bright-component integer crop; no resize or per-control registration
colorHandling: Each identical embedded Display ICC independently converted to sRGB with Pillow/LittleCMS; raw explicitly named

original-partial.wholeGlyphCoverage: Not measured; only clean matched original-all/mac12-all is used for glyph comparison
original-partial.selectionBackground: Not measured; partial fixed ROI intersects cursor halo, blur/refocus not promoted to clean matching reference

mac12-partial.wholeGlyphCoverage: Not measured; only clean matched original-all/mac12-all is used for glyph comparison
mac12-partial.selectionBackground: Not measured; partial fixed ROI intersects cursor halo, blur/refocus not promoted to clean matching reference

centerBand.comparisonLimit: No original blurred-state reference; focus absence is an endpoint, not a pixel defect

mac12-blurred.wholeGlyphCoverage: Not measured; only clean matched original-all/mac12-all is used for glyph comparison
mac12-blurred.selectionBackground: Not measured; partial fixed ROI intersects cursor halo, blur/refocus not promoted to clean matching reference

mac12-refocused.wholeGlyphCoverage: Not measured; only clean matched original-all/mac12-all is used for glyph comparison
mac12-refocused.selectionBackground: Not measured; partial fixed ROI intersects cursor halo, blur/refocus not promoted to clean matching reference

limits: Partial halo deliberately excluded, no partial-name bbox/coverage or selection-color result. Blur/refocus image and AX endpoints only; no fresh original blur/refocus pair. JPEG/AA and host differences retained; no native font/weight inference.
